description: A new Health Information Officer has joined Kenema District Health Management Team and requires DHIS2 system access. Using the DHIS2 administration module at http://localhost:8080 (admin/district), create a new user account with the following details: Username: fatmata.koroma, First name: Fatmata, Surname: Koroma, Email: fatmata.koroma@mohsl.gov.sl, Password: District2024!. Assign this user an appropriate data entry user role (look for roles related to data entry, data capture, or facility reporting — choose the most appropriate available role). Configure the user's data capture organisation units to include Kenema district (and/or its sub-units). Set the user's data view organisation units to include Sierra Leone (the national root or highest-level organisation unit). Ensure the account is enabled and not locked. After creating the user, verify the account is active by navigating to the user list and confirming the user appears.
